The '''Crintlia system''' was located in the [[Outer Jalor sector/Legends|Outer Jalor sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was situated on a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that linked it to the [[Glee Anselm system/Legends|Glee Anselm system]] in the [[Jalor sector/Legends|Jalor sector]] and the [[Moro system/Legends|Moro system]] in the [[Rago sector/Legends|Rago sector]].<ref name="EGTW" />

The Crintlia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Crintlian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="MistEncounter" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], it was a part of the territory controlled by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Crintlia system was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square I-7.<ref name="TEA" />
